source: Magic Patterns OS vnjsCrjBAfcZGnW9rHMoch, prototype “Telo Run 1” pgrYab933NWX1NZCj29RWU

not_applicable.loading: ‘searching’ is the loading state: the card spins while the browser’s list of treadmills is open.
not_applicable.empty: The supported treadmills list is fixed, and a search that finds nothing is the browser’s own chooser.
not_applicable.error: The failures are their own states: bluetooth-off, unsupported-browser, needs-https, chooser-blocked and chooser-failed.

not_applicable.loading: Telo Run 1 has one class, bundled with the app; nothing loads before the page shows. The video player fills its box when YouTube answers.
not_applicable.empty: There is always the one class. A runner with no runs yet is the default state, which simply has no stats.
not_applicable.error: The failures are their own states: no-treadmill, video-unavailable, cannot-draw, needs-chromium, needs-https and cannot-load.

not_applicable.empty: The flyover always has the course’s name and the treadmill; there is nothing to be empty of.
not_applicable.error: Its one failure is the lost treadmill (treadmill-lost). A course that cannot be drawn shows no error here: Class Run opens on the countdown instead (L2-179 AC8).

not_applicable.loading: The run itself never loads: it starts from The Class with the treadmill connected and the plan in memory. In Ibiza the course loads in its box while the run runs, which is the state ibiza-loading.
not_applicable.empty: A run always has its plan, its clock and the treadmill’s readings.
not_applicable.error: A run has three failures, each its own state: the lost treadmill (disconnected), the video that cannot play (video-unavailable) and the treadmill that gives no control (by-hand).

not_applicable.loading: The result is computed on the device when the class ends; the page has it before it opens.
not_applicable.empty: Class Done only opens after a run, so it always has an distance and eight sprints.
not_applicable.error: Telo Run 1 saves the run on the device and sends it nowhere, so there is no failure to show.

not_applicable.empty: The page is itself the empty answer to an address with no screen.
not_applicable.error: The page is itself the error.

not_applicable.busy: ‘capturing’ is the busy state: the dialog is closed while the browser asks to share the tab, and the recording mark reads “Capturing…”.
not_applicable.invalid: The note has no invalid value: an empty field turns Add note off (default), text turns it on (note-ready), and the field takes no more than 200 characters.
